<div class="funding-item">
<strong>French Government — UCAJEDI Investments in the Future</strong>

MOVICI has been supported through the UCAJEDI Investments in the Future project, managed by the French National Research Agency (ANR), reference **ANR-15-IDEX-01**.
</div>

<div class="funding-item">
<strong>Université Côte d’Azur — 2024 Scientific Incentive Credits</strong>

Additional equipment support was provided by Université Côte d’Azur through the **2024 Scientific Incentive Credits — Equipment track** (*Crédits Scientifiques Incitatifs, Volet ÉQUIPEMENTS*).
</div>
